sourceBuild: Production build served by the unmodified scripts/serve-dist.mjs
method: Fresh context per engine; official Playwright browser bundles. Select the original 15,280-byte fixture in the editor, choose BUS-01, confirm review, capture actual download and match the application receipt. Parse the downloaded bytes without rewriting in a fresh offline browser context; inspect real layout, fonts and formula provenance, then run the application page preview in the initial editor.

reproduction.common: Set PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH for the official browser distributions. If Playwright is not installed in the project, set PF_PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE to the installed playwright package. Run node evidence/rc7/verify-playwright-engines.mjs firefox and node evidence/rc7/verify-playwright-engines.mjs webkit from the repository root.
reproduction.webkit: For this Linux runtime the official Debian suite supplied missing shared libraries in a private directory. Its process-only LD_LIBRARY_PATH points to the directory; the scratch WPE sys/lib directory links the supplied libharfbuzz-icu.so.0, libhyphen.so.0 and libGLESv2.so.2. PF_ENGINE_EXECUTABLE selects the Playwright webkit-2336/pw_run.sh launcher. The operating-system installation and the deployed application are not modified.

scope: Firefox desktop headless and WebKit WPE headless; native print dialog and Safari macOS/iOS are outside this test.
